title: Wall module with a window, 1.0 m wide
description: A rendered wall module with one window: an opening 0.7 m wide and 1.1 m high whose sill is 0.9 m above the floor, centred in the width. A dark aluminium frame 4 cm wide sits in the opening and holds one pane of glass, set back 5 cm from the outer face. Same box, connectors and thickness as the plain wall module, so the two are interchangeable.

reference_pack.value_or_path: Typical sizes for a two-storey Tokyo house, chosen for this test. Not measured from a real building, so record dimension_source as "estimated".
Use only library materials from assets/mat/. Give each glTF material the library ID as its name and the values in that material.json. No custom materials and no textures in this test.

The module fills a box from x = 0 to its width, y = 0 to its height and z = -depth to 0. The outer face is the z = 0 plane and faces +Z. Nothing may reach outside the box. The window does not stand proud of the outer face.
See connector_frames in this task. Each gives a connector's position and the directions of its +Z and +Y, in the asset's own axes (+X right, +Y up, +Z front). The validator checks them.
Wall: mat_render_cream_01. Frame: mat_aluminium_dark_01. Pane: mat_glass_clear_01.
